subject: Referral routing, co-sell governance & PSA handoffs
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@grafana.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Amit Rao <amit@datadog.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Referral routing proposal: Grafana x Redwood integration

Hi Mateo / Redwood team,

Thanks for the last few syncs — Grafana is keen to make our referral handoff smooth for mutual customers that want Grafana + Redwood inference telemetry. Attached is a simple referral matrix (referral-matrix-v1.xlsx) showing the routing we use today for partners. High level asks from our side: 

- A central webhook or HubSpot queue where partner-qualified leads route into Redwood Sales.
- Clear ownership rules: when Grafana shares a lead, who owns the first outreach vs. co-sell?
- A short PSA handoff document so the initial SOW / intake includes observability requirements (OTLP endpoints, retention, metrics).

Would love to get your thoughts on thresholds (ARR, deployment model, region) that should change routing and whether Redwood can commit to an initial SLA for intake.

Proposed next step: 30–45m alignment next week to finalize routing + handoff template.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships | Grafana Labs
Attachments: referral-matrix-v1.xlsx
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@grafana.com>, Amit Rao <amit@datadog.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Referral routing proposal: Grafana x Redwood integration

Thanks Priya — this looks like a good starting point. I pulled the attachment into a shared folder and sketched how Redwood would like to approach routing and governance: 

- Routing tiers (proposal):
  * Tier A (Enterprise, ARR > $250k OR on-prem/private deployment): direct AE + co-sell lane (immediate sales sync).
  * Tier B (Mid-market, ARR $50k–$250k): SDR triage into partner queue, 48–72h response SLA, then AE assignment.
  * Tier C (SMB / POC-level): partner-led, Redwood provides enablement + intake form; auto-qualify.

- Intake mechanism: HubSpot 'partner-referrals' queue (webhook + enriched payload). We can accept a minimal webhook + optional attachment (PSA handoff).
- SLA proposal: 48 business hours for initial contact, 5 business days for PSA kickoff scheduling for Tier A/B.

I've attached a PSA handoff template (psa-handoff-template.docx) that we use as a kickoff checklist (customer contacts, OTLP/ingest info, security needs, compliance flags). Could Datadog and Observify confirm whether they need additional fields in the payload (e.g., workspace id, existing OTLP endpoint fingerprints)?

Can we lock a 60m alignment on Tue the 30th (PST) to finalize?

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Referral routing proposal: Grafana x Redwood integration

Appreciate the note — Datadog supports a similar model and a couple of points to flag from our side: 

1) Shared lead ownership: we prefer a short co-ownership window (72 hours) where both partner and vendor can engage; after that the owning AE holds the lead. This reduces double outreach and confusion.
2) Payload requirements: we need an enrichment step before the lead lands in HubSpot (company size, primary cloud region, observed telemetry scale) — Datadog can provide a small enrichment lambda if Redwood or Grafana want it.
3) PI/PD concerns: ensure the webhook excludes any customer PI that would violate either party's data retention policy. We can provide a redaction checklist.

If we align on webhook + enrichment + co-ownership window, the routing should be workable. Happy to demo our enrichment flow during the call.

— Amit Rao
Strategic Alliances | Datadog
